strings.1. ‘공식 다운로드 페이지 열기’를 눌러 Windows용 VB-CABL:
1. Click Open official download page and download the Windows VB-CABLE ZIP.
2. Extract all files. Right-click VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe and select Run as administrator.
3. Click Install Driver in the official installer. Restart the PC as instructed after installation.
4. Reopen AirEar, click Refresh in audio devices and select CABLE Input.
5. To keep the PC speakers quiet, choose CABLE Input as the output in Windows sound settings.

web.tagline: Your PC audio. One pair of earphones.
web.intro: Enter the access PIN shown in the Windows app.
web.earphones: Connect your earphones to your phone. With your PC and phone on the same Wi-Fi or LAN, hear PC audio without switching your earphones between devices.
web.background: Your phone may pause playback when the screen locks or the browser is in the background. Return and tap Listen to resume.
web.footer: Private LAN only · Up to 4 receivers
web.http: HTTP connection: PIN and credentials may be visible on the LAN. Use a trusted network and configure HTTPS in the desktop app.
web.retry_failed: Could not reconnect. Check the PIN and tap Listen again.
web.unsupported: WebRTC is unavailable in this browser. Use a current Safari or Chrome browser.
web.paused: Your phone paused playback. Tap Listen again.
web.receiving: Receiving audio · You can also use your phone volume buttons.
web.playback_stopped: The browser paused playback. Tap Listen again.
web.auth_expired: Your session expired. Enter the PIN again.
web.lan_only: Connections are allowed only from a private LAN.
web.lan_host: Connect using the PC LAN IP address.
web.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in one minute.
web.sessions_full: Authentication sessions are full. Try again later.
web.receivers_full: The maximum of four receivers is already connected.
